assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Production transparent pixel art UI atlas for Bullets of Fury, a detailed 16-bit military arcade shooter. Bottom left: same socket locked with one large crisp white question mark ? centered. Bottom right: empty ornate gunmetal square information panel, thin cyan light details, dark opaque glass center suitable for labels. Use case: stylized-concept. Production modular enemy sprite atlas for Bullets of Fury, 16-bit detailed arcade shoot-em-up. Giant menacing military SPACE BOMBER JET seen straight top down with slight 3/4 depth, NO perspective tilt. Nose faces UP because player is chasing it from below. Dark steel charcoal titanium with restrained crimson/amber lights, intricate armor and bold pixel outlines, coherent consistent lighting from upper left. EXACT 2 columns by 2 rows of isolated modules with broad transparent gutters. TOP LEFT: complete broad swept-wing jet chassis with central cockpit, no engine nacelles, no attached weapon pods, no exhaust, wing span wide and menacing, central rear bomb bay closed. TOP RIGHT: one long detachable armored jet engine nacelle, top facing UP, exhaust outlet at bottom, can be mirrored onto both wings. BOTTOM LEFT: one detachable massive forward laser cannon pod, muzzle pointing UP, mounting pivot at bottom. BOTTOM RIGHT: one rectangular open bomb-bay insert showing dark cavity and two red glowing heavy bombs, front at top. Components consistent scale and style, fully contained in their own cell, no overlap or fragments from other cells. Transparent background with genuine alpha, no checkerboard, no labels, no text, no board or scene. NOT a robot, NOT a player ship, NOT isometric.
